title: RWB-ACE-001 database slice: the ACE migration version, the ingestion job identifiers and the grantee role name are not fixed in the sources
source: Legacy RWB-ACE-001 sections 3, 5, 10 and 12; FSD P1 v3 A2.1 and open point OQ-P1-01; TSD P1 v3 T3.2 and T6.3
description: Four values this story needs are not stated in the sources: (1) the version the ACE migration takes on the ACE schema's own Flyway sequence, where the legacy file is V027__rwb_ace_001_recovery_source_additions.sql on a head of V026 and section 3 says the ACE DBA owns the schema; (2) the interface numbers, job names and cadence of the 14 ACE ingestion jobs, where legacy section 3 requires only 'a file or API contract' per source; (3) the name of the role that receives SELECT on the 14 tables and the 12 columns, which legacy AC4 calls 'the view-owner role agreed with the Workbench environment design' while the target names ace_view_owner (TSD P1 T6.3); (4) the state of DL43, the ACE acceptance of the RWB-ACE-001 scope and dates, which FSD P1 v3 OQ-P1-01 leaves open.
evidence: Legacy section 12 names V027 while section 3 fixes only the head as V026 and gives the sequence to the ACE DBA; legacy section 3 names the ingestion inputs and no interface number; legacy AC4 names no role code; FSD P1 v3 OQ-P1-01 records DL43 as open and needed by 2026-11-21.
area: ACE database, migration, ingestion and grants
owner_role: ACE team lead; ACE DBA; Recovery data architect
proposed: Keep the legacy file name and let the ACE DBA allocate the next version on the ACE sequence at build time; keep the 14 jobs as ACE Spring Batch jobs with ACE's own numbers and cadence; grant to the NOLOGIN role ace_view_owner with the 12 columns covered by the table SELECT; proceed in Draft with DL43 treated as accepted; record the two platform dependencies of the applied patterns as notes because the Work Package fixes the build dependency as None.
